To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ${\cal S}$Mssm can be obtained through a flipped $SU(5)$ GUT in a $Z_{N}$ orbifold compactified string model, with the Yukawa structure, and that R-parity and the doublet-triplets splitting can be realized.

we obtain the MSSM spectrum in the untwisted sector of a $Z_{N-I}$ orbifold with the flipped $SU(5)$ GUT symmetry, and we obtain the observed electrowak mixing angle at the low scale by running from the GUT scale with mass parameters of vector like exotics near the $M_{GUT}$ scale, and the doublet-triplets are split by the mass parameters of the vectorlike exotics.
we have found the string MSSM spectra with the correct Yukawa coupling structure in a $Z_{n-I}$ orbifold model, and that the GUT $\sin\theta_W^o$ can be run to its observed value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a string MSSM through a flipped SU(5)-like GUT, which can be embedded in a string orbifold compactification.
a new approach to the ${\cal S}$MMSM.
the construction of the MSSM from string compactification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the string MSSM is obtained with a flipped SU(5).

the ${\cal S}$MMSM can be realized from a $Z_{n-I}$ orbifold through an intermediate flipped $SU(5)$, with the Yukawa couplings of the MSSM and with R-parity, doublet-triplets splitting, and the GUT scale prediction for $\sin^2{\theta_W}$.
${\cal S}$M is obtained with the flipped SU(5)-like Yukawa coupling structure and the $Z_{12}$ orbifold compactified string theory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a $Z_{N-I}$ orbifold model is not necessarily a good model to obtain a MSSM-like spectrum, but it is a good model to get a string MSSM-like spectrum.
the flipped SU(5)$\otimes$SU(5) model is realized from string theory with the MSSM spectrum.
the ${\cal S}$MMSM is a natural outcome of the $Z_{12-1}$ orbifold with the flipped SU(5).
The main takeaway from our work is that
a string MSSM can be obtained from a flipped SU(5)$\times$U(1) GUT.
the ${\cal S}$MssM can be embedded into a $Z_{N-I}$ orbifold with $N$ a prime number.
the ${\cal S}$MMSM spectra and the GUT $\sin^{2}\theta_W^0$ can be achieved by the orbifold compactification of heterotic string with a flipped SU(5).
